subject: Q2 Kickoff: The Leaky Bucket
body: Welcome to Quarter 2. Our acquisition numbers in Q1 were legendary, but the data shows a worrying trend: users are leaving. This quarter, our North Star is Retention. If we don't fix the churn, the growth is meaningless.

subject: URGENT: Database Latency Spike
body: The checkout service is crawling. We're seeing 500 errors for 10% of users. We can patch it now with a 'Band-aid' which will restore service but might cause a crash later, or we can take the site down for 2 hours for a 'Root Cause' fix.

subject: The Support Inbox is Exploding
body: Tickets are up 400%. The team is burning out and users are threatening to cancel their subscriptions en masse. We need to do something radical to signal we care about stability.
